I first cut only the head, because I measured this generation against thad-stand-left and got 41% silhouette overlap below the collar. THE COMPARISON WAS THE WRONG WAY ROUND: thad-stand-left has his feet 100% of his width apart -- it is a WALKING pose, derived from a walking source, the same fault Hob's stand had. This generation has them together at 80%. It is a proper standing pose and the existing clip is not; I compared the good one to the bad one and blamed the good one.

He has no other art that looks up. Four facings, three talk overlays, none tilted -- which is why four rounds of 'the fix is positional' could never have worked.

LEFT, because the driver's own looking-down turns toward frame RIGHT: 107k changed pixels right of his head's centre against 51k left. Thad stands to the driver's RIGHT, facing left, looking up-left while the driver looks down-right.
